summary: Defines Shim6, a layer 3 shim that provides locator agility below the transport protocols. It gives IPv6 multihoming with failover and load sharing, without needing a site to have provider-independent address prefixes in the global routing system.

eli5.summary: A site connected through two providers has two addresses. This note adds a layer that lets conversations switch between them if one fails.

questions: how does ipv6 multihoming work with shim6
